decisions.summary: Rack-by-the-house knob is HamletSpec.harvest_weather (settled|changeable), declared, never rolled; default settled; entry 500's knob folded in.
Sawada declares harvest_weather=changeable as the pool's exhibit.

6 x 3 ft mats in rows, 1 ft inset and edge clearance, gaps 2/1.5/1 ft never below 1 ft, hand-laid nudge and turn kept only where clear of neighbors; count in [ceil(full/3), floor(2 full/3)], thinned evenly.
decisions.why: Unchanged in substance; serves the GM's aim that the drawn mats read as mats. Matches yards.py.

decisions.summary: The nudge and turn salted per yard; the turn up to 10 degrees where the neighbors leave room.
decisions.why: A degree of the hand-laid convention already ruled within; it removes a repeated stamp so the floor reads as mats laid by hand. No change to count or placement rules.

decisions.summary: A yard that physically cannot hold a third at a 1 ft gap draws as many as fit at it, at any size.
decisions.why: As ruled in round 5: the third is this project's proxy, and forcing it where it cannot fit at the least legible gap defeats the GM's aim. Measured this round (brute force, every quarter-foot lattice origin at a 1 ft gap, corners 1 ft inside the drawn outline, off the padded rack): eight of the nine short pool yards are genuinely fit-limited (drawn = most that fit).

decisions.summary: 'Cannot reach a third at 1 ft' decided by the lattice search mat_cells runs: four lattice sizes, each at five offsets per axis (centered, half and all the way across its slack).
decisions.why: Still excuses a yard that CAN hold a third. Kashikawa's 27.1 x 18.7 ft yard (manifest x 1036.7, y 886.0, no rack) draws 9 against a third of 10, and a 1 ft lattice of 3 x 4 seats 12 (local origin about (-11.3, -7.3); the rows fit in a 0.2 ft window of y, which the five offsets per axis step over). The result holds with the edge clearance raised to 1.05 ft to cover the SVG outline's 0.1 px rounding. The exception's words are 'cannot hold'; a coarse search that misses a fitting lattice is the alignment failure round 5 ruled out, now on one yard instead of eight.

decisions.summary: The short-yard floor is four mats.
decisions.why: Restored to the form ruled LEGITIMATE; it bounds the exception rather than widening it. The smallest rolled yard (Inashiro's 20 x 14 ft, 8 tsubo) measures 4 fit and 4 drawn.

decisions.summary: Rack along a side edge inset 1 ft, near half preferred, off the yard's map-south half solved in map coordinates, whole-side fallback.
Threshing yard docstring rewritten from 025 and 505 with labels and the GM's convention wording.
decisions.why: FR-007. The new '(a yard whose outline or rack leaves no room for the last one, a mat fewer)' understates Inashiro's 4 of 6 (two fewer) - a wording fix recorded in the spec verdict, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: Regenerate the five pool hamlets; the settlement-reviews the gate owes; make done.
